text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother! Rice... Rice is...!
choice_data_list: We were so close, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Big Sis! Rice, Rice is...!"
choice_data_list: We were so close, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's so frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was so close to catching up...! But I 
failed again...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I wanted to beat 
Bourbon-san, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyawa! Bourbon-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —I was truly amazed by your run today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Why were you able to run so 
brilliantly...? It leaves me with no 
choice but to wonder."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And I've reached one conclusion. ...You 
often used to say it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "To catch up to me," she said.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it was completely beyond 
comprehension. In a race, there is only 
victory, or defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The concept of "catching up" does not 
exist. However—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Can you hear it, Rice-san?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah------!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was an amazing race! Bourbon! Rice-!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of this year's stars! We're 
looking forward to seeing you two next 
year as well!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No way. Rice is getting applause 
too... not just Bourbon-san?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But Rice is still... compared to 
Bourbon-san...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. I agree with them. Right now, we stand 
as equals.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I hereby declare.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I won't lose to you either. 
—As your rival."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ri... vals.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san. Will you accept a challenge from 
me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! R-Rice is...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice doesn't want to lose either! Next 
time... I will... win...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Rice Shower's voice resonated through the 
air. It was a loud, powerful declaration, 
heard by those beside her and throughout 
the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that her talent can blossom even 
further. I consider candidate races she 
should choose next as a stayer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a starting point for everything, 
preparations for the Nikkei Sho got 
underway.
